crossRefs.note: ‘Have they not found, have they not divided the plunder? A lady, two ladies to every man; to Sisera a plunder of dyed…
“Kings of armies flee! They flee!” She who waits at home divides the plunder,
She is not afraid of the snow for her household; for all her household are clothed with scarlet.
Moreover Yahweh said, “Because the daughters of Zion are arrogant, and walk with outstretched necks and flirting eyes…
“Can a virgin forget her ornaments, or a bride her attire? Yet my people have forgotten me for days without number.
In the same way, that women also adorn themselves in decent clothing, with modesty and propriety, not just with braided…
but with good works, which is appropriate for women professing godliness.
Let your beauty be not just the outward adorning of braiding the hair, and of wearing jewels of gold, or of putting on…

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

people.name: Saul
people.line: First king of Israel, anointed by Samuel

translations.web: You daughters of Israel, weep over Saul, who clothed you delicately in scarlet, who put ornaments of gold on your clothing.
translations.bsb: O daughters of Israel, weep for Saul, who clothed you in scarlet and luxury, who decked your garments with ornaments of gold.
translations.kjv: Ye daughters of Israel, weep over Saul, who clothed you in scarlet, with other delights, who put on ornaments of gold upon your apparel.
translations.asv: Ye daughters of Israel, weep over Saul, Who clothed you in scarlet delicately, Who put ornaments of gold upon your apparel.
